extractions.description: Kubric is an Python framework designed to generate synthetic data with rich annotations for machine learning tasks. It is especially useful in artificial data generation for tasks such as 3D NeRF models and optical flow estimation. It utilizes rendering engines like Blender for high realism and scales to large operations to generate extensive datasets for deep learning training and testing.
